context: GH #371 — ui-super-shell's ruled bar-seam redesign (Kim, 2026-07-30): the frame drops its gap, bars own their seam inside their own box, panes' bar-facing corners square off against bars. Design record: ADR-0166 (proposed). Sources: super-shell.css:85-91 (frame), :99-107 (bar, GH #253), :166-177 (GH #214 resizer-owns-the-gap precedent), shell-archetypes-m5.spec.md SPEC-R11a/R11c/AC19. Constraints: the bars-free (inert single-child) arm stays byte-stable; middle's inter-card inline gaps + radii are preserved verbatim; AC19's allowlist stays at exactly 2; corner-squaring is per-side.

nodes.label: frame block-axis spacing owner
nodes.accept: `! grep -q "gap: var(--ui-super-shell-gap)" <(sed -n '/\[data-part=.frame.\]/,/^  }/p' packages/agent-ui/app/src/controls/super-shell/super-shell.css)` exits 0 AND on a header+footer fixture `getComputedStyle(frame).rowGap` reads `'normal'` or `'0px'`

nodes.label: header bar's block-end seam edge
nodes.accept: on a header-bearing fixture `getComputedStyle(header).borderBlockEndWidth === '1px'` AND `Math.abs(header.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - middle.getBoundingClientRect().top) <= 1`

nodes.label: footer bar's block-start seam edge
nodes.accept: on a footer-bearing fixture `getComputedStyle(footer).borderBlockStartWidth === '1px'` AND `Math.abs(middle.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - footer.getBoundingClientRect().top) <= 1`

nodes.label: bar seam token (consumer repoint seam)
nodes.accept: `--ui-super-shell-bar-seam` is declared in the `:where(ui-super-shell)` token block AND a test that sets `--ui-super-shell-bar-seam: 3px solid red` on the host measures `borderBlockEndWidth === '3px'` on the header bar (the TKT-0062 repoint-the-token law, proven live not asserted)

nodes.label: bar outer-height invariance under the seam
nodes.accept: on a header-bearing fixture `Math.round(header.getBoundingClientRect().height) === 54` — the 1px border is absorbed inside `min-block-size: var(--ui-super-shell-bar-size)` by the bar's existing `box-sizing: border-box` (super-shell.css:104); negative control: flip that declaration to `content-box` and this assertion must read 55

nodes.label: block-axis radius token pair
nodes.accept: `--ui-super-shell-radius-block-start` and `--ui-super-shell-radius-block-end` are declared in the `:where(ui-super-shell)` token block, each `var(--ui-super-shell-radius)`, and `npm test -- shell-spacing-gate` exits 0 (a `var(...)` arm is skipped by AC19's `mintedArmLiterals`)

nodes.label: frame-level bar-presence selectors
nodes.accept: super-shell.css contains `[data-part='frame']:has(> [data-bar='header'])` and `[data-part='frame']:has(> [data-bar='footer'])` rules setting the two radius tokens to 0; a jsdom source-presence pin reds if either selector is removed

nodes.label: carded parts' radius consumption (rail · pane · pane-resizer)
nodes.accept: no `border-radius:` shorthand remains on the `[data-part='rail']`/`[data-part='pane']`/`[data-part='pane-resizer']` rules; each consumes the four logical longhands off the token pair — `! grep -qE "^\s+border-radius: var\(--ui-super-shell-radius\)" packages/agent-ui/app/src/controls/super-shell/super-shell.css` exits 0

nodes.label: floating-overlay posture restore (all six overlay arms)
nodes.accept: with a collapse side overlay-open at 360px on a header+footer shell, all four logical longhands on the overlaid pane read `18px`; negative control: delete the token restore from the narrow overlay arm (super-shell.css:424-436) and the assertion must red naming `border-start-start-radius`

nodes.label: narrow-stack column-posture corner rule
nodes.accept: at 360px with `narrow-start='stack'` on a header+footer shell: the stacked side's block-START longhands read `0px` and its block-END longhands read `18px` (its block-end faces canvas, not the footer); with `narrow-end='stack'` the pairing inverts. Encodes ADR-0166 cl.6's ruled fork F2

nodes.label: narrow-tabs strip seam + block-end posture restore
nodes.accept: at 360px on a `tabs`-side shell with a footer: `Math.abs(narrowTabs.getBoundingClientRect().top - middle.getBoundingClientRect().bottom)` equals the strip's own declared seam (not 0 and not 18 by accident — the value ADR-0166 cl.7 rules), AND the active narrow-tab pane's block-end longhands read `18px` (its block-end faces the strip, not the footer)

nodes.label: preserved inline-axis geometry (middle gaps · resizer net footprint)
nodes.accept: `git diff --exit-code -- packages/agent-ui/app/src/controls/super-shell/super-shell-resize-tabs.browser.test.ts` exits 0 AND that file's GH #214 suite (`:437-473`) plus the 846px natural-fit sweep (`:528-532`) pass unedited — the frame's gap was a ROW gap and never fed the inline arithmetic

nodes.label: consumer hairline repair — docs site chrome
nodes.accept: `_page.css`'s header rule (`:110-113`) no longer declares `border-block-end` (the component owns it) and `.app-context-footer` (`:161-163`) no longer declares `border-block-start`; a browser assertion counts exactly ONE 1px block-axis border across the docs shell's header bar box and its bar-content descendant, and exactly one across the footer pair

nodes.label: flush-seam measurement suite (real engine)
nodes.accept: a new `describe` in `super-shell.browser.test.ts` covering n1/n3/n4/n6 passes in BOTH engines under `npm run test:browser` (shard `packages:app`), exit code 0 read from the shard, never a piped grep

nodes.label: corner-matrix suite — four bar configurations × three carded parts
nodes.accept: four fixtures (no bars · header only · footer only · header+footer) each assert the FOUR logical longhands individually per carded part, matching ADR-0166 cl.5's table; the suite must never read the `borderRadius` shorthand (`0px 0px 18px 18px` collapses to a string the old `not.toBe('0px')` predicate passes vacuously)

nodes.label: inert-arm byte-stability probe (bars-free shells)
nodes.accept: a bars-free fixture using agent-admin's slot set (`content` + `options-pane`) and gen-ui-live's (`nav-pane` + `content`) asserts all four longhands read `18px` on every carded part AND `pane.getBoundingClientRect().top === middle.getBoundingClientRect().top` AND `frame.getBoundingClientRect().height === middle.getBoundingClientRect().height`; negative control: remove the `> ` child combinator from the frame `:has()` selectors so a nested shell's bar matches, and this probe must red

nodes.label: AC19 baseline verification + a biting negative control
nodes.accept: `npm test -- shell-spacing-gate` exits 0 with `ALLOWLIST.length` still 2 and zero edits to `site/lib/shell-spacing-gate.test.ts`; negative control: add `--ui-super-shell-bar-seam-probe: 1.125rem` to the token block (a token appearing NOWHERE else — never anchor on `1px`, which occurs in `_page.css` comments and its `-1px` outlier), confirm the mutation applied via `grep -q bar-seam-probe`, confirm AC19 reds naming `1.125rem`, then revert

nodes.label: the #253 regression test, repaired under the narrowed ruling
nodes.accept: `super-shell.browser.test.ts:125`'s `it('rail/pane/pane-resizer (floating cards) KEEP their radius…')` is REWRITTEN (not deleted, not loosened) to assert per-side longhands with an ADR-0166 citation — its `mountFullChrome()` fixture authors BOTH bars, so under the new rule the shorthand computes `0px` and the current `not.toBe('0px')` predicate reds; the replacement must still red if the INLINE-axis radii are lost

nodes.label: docs-shell visual baseline re-base (reviewed)
nodes.accept: `npm run test:browser` shard `visual` exits 0 after a re-base whose diff is named in the commit body (which seam moved, by how many px, on which fixture) — never a blind `test:visual:update`

nodes.label: jsdom source-presence pins
nodes.accept: `npm test` exits 0 with pins (the `super-shell.test.ts:239` forced-colors precedent) for the two frame `:has()` rules, the two bar seam declarations, and each overlay-arm token restore — so a deleted rule reds without a browser

nodes.label: ADR-0166 + README index row + derived-index regen
nodes.accept: `.claude/docs/adr/0166-super-shell-bars-own-their-seam.md` exists with Status `proposed`, exactly one README index row whose status cell reads `proposed`, `node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs` run, and `npm test -- adr docs-grammar` exits 0

nodes.label: SPEC-R11a/AC19 amendment sheet (lands at the ratification gate)
nodes.accept: the amendment text ships INSIDE ADR-0166 (a §Amendment-sheet section naming the exact R11a sentence to change and the AC19 clause note), with zero edits to the accepted SPEC body pre-ratification — `git diff --exit-code -- .claude/docs/spec/shell-archetypes-m5.spec.md` exits 0 on this branch

edges.why: ADR-0166 resolves the M1-vs-M2 seam fork; deleting the frame gap before the fork is ratified-as-proposed would build an unrecorded mechanism
the presence selectors set the two tokens — the tokens must exist and carry their default before a selector can zero them
the carded parts consume the tokens; consuming an undeclared custom property computes to the initial value (square everywhere), the exact defect this ordering avoids
the overlay restore overrides an INHERITED token value by declaring it on the card itself — there is nothing to override until the frame-level rules exist
same override direction: the narrow-stack rule re-declares on the card what the frame set
same override direction for the narrow-tabs posture restore
the strip's own seam only becomes necessary once the frame's gap that used to space it is gone
the consumer's hairline may only be removed once the component actually draws one — dropping it first leaves the docs shell with no separator at all
the #253 test's fixture squares only once the carded parts consume the tokens; repairing the assertion earlier pins a shape the tree does not yet have
the corner-matrix suite asserts the longhands the consumption rule introduces
the flush-seam suite measures the zero seam the gap deletion creates
the visual baseline must be re-based against the FINAL docs-shell pixels, after the duplicate hairline is gone — re-basing earlier bakes in a two-hairline frame
same serialization: the baseline is the last pixel-truth step, taken after every geometry leaf lands
the inert-arm probe must be green before a baseline update can be trusted not to be laundering an unnoticed inert-arm regression
the amendment sheet is a section OF ADR-0166; it cannot exist before the record does
